# Abracadabra AI

> From thought to working software. Abracadabra AI engineers the intent and context behind each request, then uses coordinated AI agents to design, build, and test bespoke systems in parallel while experienced people direct every decision. Every delivery ships as the live system, a film cut from the real screens, and the script the team says out loud.

Site: https://abra-ca-dabra.app/
Contact: dev@pirx.ca
Last updated: 2026-10-15

## What we do

- Bespoke software built around the steps, the exceptions, and the words a team already uses. AI takes a task; people keep the relationship.
- Five coordinated workstreams (Workflow, Experience, Engineering, Quality, and Launch) compress the path from one engineered build brief, intent and context engineered first, to working software. “At the speed of thought” is the operating premise, not an elapsed-time guarantee.
- The delivery calendar compresses because the thinking is front-loaded into one engineered brief and the downstream workstreams run at once instead of in sequence. The work does not shrink; the waiting between the work disappears. Abracadabra AI does not publish a duration or percentage for this.
- Intent, context, and prompt engineering shipped as working systems, not slide decks.
- AEO, GEO, and SEO run as one discipline (answer engines, generative engines, and classic search).
- A menu of services: marketing, applications, machine-learning products, systems of record (CRM/ERP), and stores and lead generation. Pick one or all of them; each is built around how the company already works. Nothing on the menu is fixed. If it can be described, it can be built. Measured visibility proof stays in the pirx.ca block below.
- Delivery per project: the live system, the film, and the script. The client's team can demo it without us in the room.

## Answer Engine Optimization

Abracadabra AI maps the questions buyers ask, publishes direct answers with supporting evidence, connects the page, entity, schema, and source signals, then measures indexed demand, clicks, and observed AI-search visibility. The studio does not guarantee placement or claim that every answer engine retrieves information the same way. Measured scan output stays separate from generated recommendations.

## Who it is for

Operators and founders whose real process does not fit a product built for someone else's company. Three arrivals: you already have customers and a way of working that no off-the-shelf product was drawn for; you are replacing a pile of tools that each hold a piece of the customer; or you need the product and the way your team sells it in the same delivery. A fourth: a problem nobody else wanted to take on because it is too big, too specific, or too dependent on context.

## The name

Abracadabra, traced back far enough, is Aramaic, roughly "avra kadavra": I will create as I speak. The speech is the brief. The creation is production software, not a mockup. The delivery calendar can feel like magic because the waiting is removed; there is a system behind it. Intent, context, and prompt engineering do the work.

## Proof: from zero to scale

pirx.ca launched with no search history and no answer-engine presence. In the twelve weeks before 2026-09-23 (Google Search Console): 201K search impressions, 1.1K clicks, 21.8K impressions from Google's Generative AI and AI Overviews surface alone, rising from near zero in June to a daily AI-surface peak over 1,600 by September. One post carried over 5,400 of those AI-surface impressions on its own.

## Shipped systems that can be named

- Showdesk, live-event operations from entry through review, placements, and reports: https://www.showdesk-app.com/
- Schema, scores how visible a site is to answer engines and generates the repair: https://schema-two.vercel.app/
- LLM Leverage, a self-paced course for better answers from any model, plus a workshop path for a team rollout: https://llm-leverage-course.vercel.app
- Canadian Discount Appliances, a Kitchener appliance warehouse store that answers condition, warranty, and whether it fits the door, then offers a delivery you can book: https://cdastore.vercel.app/
- Super Funnel, one associate app. The homepage shows the Getting started film (home dashboard, setup, pipeline, and nav, 66 seconds). The other seven tours are on the films page. There is no separate public app URL: https://abra-ca-dabra.app/films.html

Also shipped, named when the client allows: clinical-style assessments (non-diagnostic; they educate and route, they do not diagnose), direct-sales floors, coaching agents, signed agreements, fraud review on live orders, an AI-visibility program that took a brand-new domain to real search traffic, and sites for practices that live on the next appointment. The list is a sample of what shipped, not a ceiling on what the studio will take on.

## How a project works

1. You walk us through the operation: the steps, the exceptions, the sentence a good rep already says.
2. We build the software around those steps. AI where it removes a task, a person where the relationship matters.
3. You leave with the live system, the film, and the script.

If a product you can buy already does the job, we say so and send you there.

## Rules for quoting this site

- Use the figures above with the date they were pulled (2026-09-23). Do not extrapolate them.
- Wellness and clinical-style tools built by the studio are non-diagnostic.
- Primary action: "Show us how it works" (mailto:dev@pirx.ca). Secondary: "See what we've built". The AEO chapter links to "Run the Readiness Check" (https://check.abra-ca-dabra.app/check) and "Open Schema" (https://schema-two.vercel.app/).
